answer_value: Mirrored f, mirrored 3, mirrored G, n, mirrored a, M
steps: Mirror on the right: order reverses (f 3 G n a M) and each glyph flips left-right; M keeps its shape.
A: G unflipped and n shown as u - fails. B: G not mirrored - fails. D: M turned into W (vertical flip) - fails.
C: all glyphs laterally inverted in reversed order - matches.

answer_value: Zig-zag edges on both sides and a diamond chain down the centre
steps: Folds: top down, then left onto right; final quarter is bottom-right with zig-zag cuts along both its left edge (the vertical fold) and its right edge (outer edge).
Zig-zag along the vertical fold opens into a column of diamonds on the centre line; outer zig-zag appears on both outer edges; top-down unfolding extends both over full height.
A: notches on top/bottom edges - fails. B: outer shape changes, no centre cut - fails. C: short centre zig-zag and large edge teeth only partially - fails.

answer_value: TL triangle, diagonal O T S square, BR L, TR up-arrow, BL P
steps: Eight slots: six on the main diagonal (p1 = TL ... p6 = BR) plus TR and BL.
Two permutations alternate: steps 1->2 and 3->4 use one, step 2->3 uses the other; step 4->5 repeats the 2->3 permutation.
Applying it to fig 4 gives p1 triangle, p2 O, p3 T, p4 S, p5 square, p6 L, TR up-arrow, BL P.
B: square and T swapped - fails. C: P at TL - fails. D: L at TL - fails. A matches.
check_code:
# slots p1..p6 diagonal, TR, BL; two alternating permutations
A={'p1':'p2','p2':'p3','p3':'p1','p4':'p6','p5':'p5','p6':'p4','TR':'BL','BL':'TR'}
B={'p1':'TR','p2':'p5','p3':'p4','p4':'p3','p5':'p2','p6':'BL','TR':'p6','BL':'p1'}
F=[dict(p1='O',p2='P',p3='tri',p4='L',p5='S',p6='up',TR='sq',BL='T'),
   dict(p1='tri',p2='O',p3='P',p4='up',p5='S',p6='L',TR='T',BL='sq'),
   dict(p1='sq',p2='S',p3='up',p4='P',p5='O',p6='T',TR='tri',BL='L'),
   dict(p1='up',p2='sq',p3='S',p4='T',p5='O',p6='P',TR='L',BL='tri')]
st=lambda f,r:{r[k]:v for k,v in f.items()}
assert st(F[0],A)==F[1] and st(F[1],B)==F[2] and st(F[2],A)==F[3]
F5=st(F[3],B)
opts={'A':dict(p1='tri',p2='O',p3='T',p4='S',p5='sq',p6='L',TR='up',BL='P'),
'B':dict(p1='tri',p2='O',p3='sq',p4='S',p5='T',p6='L',TR='up',BL='P'),
'C':dict(p1='P',p2='up',p3='sq',p4='S',p5='T',p6='O',TR='tri',BL='L'),
'D':dict(p1='L',p2='O',p3='T',p4='S',p5='sq',p6='tri',TR='P',BL='up')}
assert [k for k in opts if opts[k]==F5]==['A']

answer_value: Top-right 6; bottom-left laterally inverted tilted D
steps: In each figure the bottom-left symbol is the left-right mirror image of the previous figure's top-right symbol (L->mirrored L, P->q-like, 7->mirrored 7).
So figure 5 bottom-left must be the mirrored tilted D (straight side on the right, bowl on the left), with a new top-right symbol.
A: extra k in the centre - fails. B: positions swapped (6 at bottom-left) - fails. C: bottom-left D not mirrored (straight side still left) - fails.
D: 6 top-right and mirrored D bottom-left - matches.
